analysis:
Scope: DistributedInstalledPairServingGrant.swift, base 504-786 and head 1-828. ClusterApprovalAttachment.swift is covered from metadata and the patch excerpt only; no source text was supplied.

(1) Grant evidence records. The grant now carries the records it rests on (head 185-193). evidenceSHA256 (head 203-205) hashes canonical JSON Lines for a release's evidence_sha256. These records are the uncontradicted passing evidence (head 474-476). Grant/withheld decision logic is unchanged (head 428-482 vs base). Release-side comparison with this digest is not visible.

(2) Owner-declared families. ownerServing and publicTrafficLine (head 649-674, 818-827) now merge ClusterPublicModels.declared families with record-derived grant families. The result is UI text claiming "qualified for public traffic", even for declared families with no passing record. publicTrafficLine returns tensorAssistantNotOffered when tensorAssistant is set (head 788-792, 824). The code says the coordinator's parity qualification still decides each placement.

The ClusterPublicModels source is not supplied. It must be confirmed that declared families are display-only and never relax the coordinator-offer or approval gating. Otherwise an owner could self-declare public serving without cross-cable evidence. That would touch T-007/T-056 output-correctness assumptions and TB-011-style authorization being self-asserted. grant() itself (head 616-629) still ignores declared families, so the visible public grant is unchanged. I raised no finding because the offer path is outside the evidence.

(3) ClusterApprovalAttachment.swift. Per the patch excerpt, attach now runs the full ClusterConfiguration.validate with the attachment (head 134-139), not only ClusterNativeMemberAttachment.validate. That appears to strengthen checks. The full head line text is not supplied, so this cannot be verified.

Integration should check:
- ClusterPublicModels.declared provenance and its consumers (coordinator offer, ClusterConfiguration.tensorAssistantServesLocally).
- Whether the release facts' evidence_sha256 is verified against grant.evidenceSHA256.
